item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 21/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night over Guangdong today and tomorrow. Meanwhile, with the broad band of rain and clouds covering the coast of southern China thinning out, the weather will become brighter over the region. Daytime temperatures will rise slightly in the latter part of this week. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. It will be windy with one or two rain patches over the region. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China early next week. Temperatures will fall appreciably over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. It will be cool in the morning and at night.
